description: The spoken name of a destination, language-neutral: describeDestination(destination, { index, count, current, messages }) from core/src/navigation-bar/text.ts. The parts are the label, the badge's label, the position from navigationBar.position when index and count are given, and navigationBar.current when current is true, joined with ", ". messages holds catalog overrides by key, as a locale would give them; absent, the English catalog applies. The position counts only the destinations passed: a hidden destination is not counted. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.

cases.name: A position on a mobile tab bar
A badge comes before the position
A count badge reads its label, not its content
The current marker on a desktop list
The position counts only the destinations passed
The unavailable reason is not part of the name
A locale translates the current marker
